lines.text: The men of Ephraim crossed the Jordan to Zaphon and threatened to burn Jephthah's house down with him inside.
Jephthah said he risked his life and crossed over to the Ammonites, and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
Jephthah gathered the men of Gilead and fought Ephraim, and the Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan.
The Gileadites killed those who could not say Shibboleth at the Jordan fords, and 24,000 Ephraimites died.
Jephthah judged Israel six years and was buried in a city of Gilead, and Ibzan of Shiloh judged next.
